findings.baseline_title: The public draft bypasses edit tracking, validation cancellation, and isolation
findings.required_outcome: Track private edits; detach read-only drafts and Dates; preserve explicit transient empty values.

findings.baseline_title: Invalid control text can be submitted as an absent optional value
findings.required_outcome: A component-owned invalid-edit event blocks submission independently of candidate key presence.

findings.baseline_title: A completed mutation can report success or errors into a newer form session
findings.required_outcome: Bind post-await completion, errors and pending flags to the originating form generation.

findings.baseline_title: Submitting while blur validation is pending silently drops the request
findings.required_outcome: A single Save intent supersedes blur validation instead of disappearing.

findings.baseline_title: DialogForm freezes which Form props are present at setup
findings.required_outcome: Forward current component props and current model presence, not an initial snapshot.

findings.baseline_title: ListView no longer implements a controlled query round trip
findings.required_outcome: Use one controlled-parent/uncontrolled-Collection query owner with exactly one update event.

findings.baseline_title: Default enum inference does not feed the built-in SelectInput
findings.required_outcome: Delete automatic renderer/enum-choice synthesis; require canonical explicit selector props.

findings.baseline_title: Hard-coded renderer-kind checks reject supported numeric selections
findings.required_outcome: Derive model/prop compatibility from components; remove the independent renderer-kind matrix.

findings.baseline_title: Schema-derived requiredness stops before reaching the input component
findings.required_outcome: Pass schema-derived requiredness to the component after authored props.

findings.baseline_title: permission: null bypasses server-declared row-operation policy
findings.required_outcome: Null permission still goes through the row-policy access seam.

findings.baseline_title: A bound delete can mutate a different identity than the one checked
findings.required_outcome: Bind immutable scalar/composite identities and detached policy context.

findings.baseline_title: Custom commands guess context from Function.length and can drop real payloads
findings.required_outcome: Bind context with withContext; preserve the exact business run/can argument tuple.

findings.baseline_title: Resources are not complete page-prop composers
findings.required_outcome: Derive declarations and forwarding from complete canonical View contracts.

findings.baseline_title: FormView replaces inherited action labels and the normal actions slot
findings.required_outcome: Use nested Form labels and the standard actions slot; remove wrapper aliases.

findings.baseline_title: TreeTable bypasses shared rendering for its tree column
findings.required_outcome: Render the tree column through DisplayValue with original-record/accessor semantics.

findings.baseline_title: Lookup hydration overwrites a newer staged selection
findings.required_outcome: Separate committed hydration from edited staging generations.

findings.baseline_title: FileInput ignores its disabled contract at mutation entry points
findings.required_outcome: Block disabled asset mutation handlers and govern accepted in-flight work by token.

findings.baseline_title: Union guards accept a valid member and overlook an invalid one
findings.required_outcome: Check whole unions/all keys; validate result identity before presentation independently of routes.

findings.baseline_title: Managed input slots erase field-specific value and setter types
findings.required_outcome: Use field-keyed typed slots and one read-only draft/ref contract across wrappers.

findings.baseline_title: The test suite has useful coverage, but several claimed guarantees are not tested
findings.required_outcome: Use real controls and plausible broken counterexamples; remove tautological/incidental assertions.

findings.baseline_title: The web workflow does not run Loom unit tests
findings.required_outcome: Run Loom unit and tooling suites explicitly; include matching workflow triggers.

findings.baseline_title: The public type surface retains the full schema/literal graph and exports its proof machinery
findings.required_outcome: Return compact named contracts with useful refinements; hide proof aliases and measure fairly.

findings.baseline_title: UI-to-transport query conversion is copied into each resource module
findings.required_outcome: Encode the unchanged HTTP query protocol once in the existing Hono adapter.

findings.baseline_title: Unused legacy identity declarations and redundant runtime aliases remain
findings.required_outcome: Delete unused identity declaration helpers and identical runtime aliases.

findings.baseline_title: Active agent guidance still teaches contracts the implementation removed
findings.required_outcome: Compile actual examples; align root docs, nested skills and generators with real owners.

findings.baseline_title: An asynchronous close guard can close a dialog after submission begins
findings.required_outcome: Recheck close generation/busy state after awaited guard approval.

findings.baseline_title: Input hydration discards an adapter’s intentional null result
findings.required_outcome: Delete generic input hydration; preserve global asset reader null without raw-value fallback.

decisions.decision: Supported native attributes are explicit typed component API; flat props, no arbitrary extras or blanket Partial.
Configure one app-level asset service for direct/managed inputs, previews and display. No per-field adapter.
Every authored input names its renderer; schemas derive requiredness, not UI choices.
Resource loaders are passed through canonical component props. Delete field source and generic input prop adapters.
Form forwards actual component Vue models and validity events; no Form-only coercion or hydration.
Keep default submit, explicit overrides, flat Form/DialogForm and nested complete View bags.
Share labels, input props, business catalogs, display accessors/renderers/formats without a universal field.
Keep backend contracts unchanged; deliberate schema, asset-service and transport boundaries have explicit owners.
Finish with no executable legacy paths, duplicate contracts, unsupported tests, or stale active authoring examples.

limits: Plans use source inspection and previously recorded isolated evidence. No implementation, pinned workspace/Vue/browser test run, storage/API integration, or new benchmark was performed in this planning pass.
